title: Camera timeout after wakeup
description: Camera service timeout can occur immediately after vehicle wakeup.
solution: Upgrade Camera Stack to 4.2.3 or later.

title: CAN communication unavailable after restart
description: CAN communication may be unavailable after ECU restart.
solution: Upgrade gateway software to the corrected release.

title: Brake status delayed during wakeup
description: Brake status may arrive late immediately after network wakeup.
root_cause: Low message scheduling priority during network recovery.
solution: Apply corrected message priority configuration.

title: Brake diagnostics timeout under load
description: Brake diagnostic requests may time out when ECU startup load is high.
root_cause: Diagnostic timeout too short for startup conditions.
solution: Use the updated diagnostic timeout configuration.

title: ADAS calibration package missing
description: ADAS camera calibration may fail when calibration data is absent from the deployment package.
solution: Validate calibration package inclusion before deployment.

title: Lane detection stream lost after restart
description: Lane detection may stop after perception processor restart.
solution: Enable automatic perception stream reconnection.

title: Lidar initialization stuck
description: Lidar may remain in an initialization state after cold boot.
root_cause: Readiness event consumed before service subscription.
solution: Correct startup event subscription ordering.

title: Lidar stream stops during endurance test
description: Point-cloud streaming may stop during long-running tests.
solution: Increase buffer capacity and enable backpressure handling.

title: Radar heartbeat missing after resume
description: Radar heartbeat may be absent after system resume.
root_cause: Heartbeat timer not restored after suspend.
solution: Restart the heartbeat timer during resume.

title: Radar stale objects
description: Radar objects may remain visible after the sensor reports an empty scene.
solution: Clear the object cache on empty sensor frames.

title: Infotainment black screen
description: Infotainment display may remain black after boot.
root_cause: Graphics compositor starts before graphics driver readiness.
solution: Correct graphics service startup dependency ordering.

title: Touchscreen unavailable after resume
description: Touch input may stop responding after low-power resume.
solution: Re-register input devices during resume.

title: GPS unavailable after startup
description: GPS position may remain unavailable during early startup.
solution: Defer configuration until receiver readiness.

title: GPS time sync failure
description: GPS time synchronization may fail before satellite acquisition.
root_cause: Synchronization attempted without valid GPS fix.
solution: Retry synchronization after position acquisition.

title: Battery SOC update delayed
description: Battery state of charge may remain stale after ignition.
solution: Apply the corrected battery polling configuration.

title: Battery voltage missing after wakeup
description: Battery voltage signal may be unavailable after network wakeup.
solution: Restore signal subscriptions during wakeup.

title: Cooling fan command ignored
description: Cooling fan commands may be rejected during certain thermal states.
solution: Apply the corrected thermal controller state machine.

title: Temperature value frozen
description: Temperature sensor values may stop updating during diagnostic activity.
root_cause: Sensor polling blocked by diagnostic processing.
solution: Separate sensor polling from diagnostic processing.

title: Door status stale after unlock
description: Door status may remain locked briefly after successful unlock.
root_cause: Status event published before controller state confirmation.
solution: Publish status after state confirmation.

title: Door ECU disappears from network
description: Door ECU may disappear after sleep/wakeup cycles.
solution: Correct ECU and network-manager sleep coordination.

title: Lighting command latency
description: Lighting commands may be delayed during vehicle state changes.
solution: Prioritize lighting commands during state transitions.

title: High beam state mismatch
description: High beam application state may differ from switch state.
solution: Use sequence validation for lighting events.

title: HVAC unavailable after wakeup
description: HVAC controller may not respond immediately after wakeup.
root_cause: HVAC channel initialized before network readiness.
solution: Delay channel initialization until network readiness.

title: HVAC temperature target lost
description: Cabin temperature target may be lost after power cycle.
root_cause: Target stored only in volatile memory.
solution: Persist target in non-volatile configuration.

title: Audio service startup failure
description: Audio service may fail to start during cold boot.
solution: Enforce audio hardware service dependency.

title: Audio stops after Bluetooth reconnect
description: Audio playback may stop after Bluetooth reconnect.
solution: Recreate audio session after transport reconnect.

title: Bluetooth pairing timeout
description: Bluetooth pairing may time out immediately after startup.
solution: Queue pairing requests until stack initialization completes.

title: Bluetooth device missing after sleep
description: Previously paired Bluetooth devices may disappear after sleep.
solution: Reload pairing database during resume.

title: USB device not detected at startup
description: USB storage may not be detected when connected during startup.
solution: Retry enumeration after controller readiness.

title: USB transfer timeout
description: Large USB transfers may fail intermittently.
solution: Increase transfer timeout and use retries.

title: Secure token rejected after clock change
description: Security token validation may fail after a system clock adjustment.
root_cause: Stale trusted time used for validation.
solution: Refresh trusted time before validation.

title: Certificate renewal missed
description: Certificate renewal may not trigger at the configured threshold.
solution: Use UTC consistently for renewal scheduling.

title: OTA download interrupted
description: OTA download may stop during network transitions.
root_cause: Download client does not resume correctly.
solution: Enable resumable download handling.

title: OTA package checksum mismatch
description: OTA package validation may fail despite a successful download.
solution: Use the corrected checksum calculation.

title: Network wakeup message burst
description: A burst of network messages may be observed immediately after wakeup.
solution: Apply staggered startup/retry timing to reduce the burst.
